transcript.speaker: p-dmitri
transcript.text: Morning. Okay, let's keep it quick. Lin, how's the life test rig?

transcript.speaker: p-lin
transcript.text: Good morning. Cycle count is still climbing, no faults overnight. One of the encoder cables is looking a bit frayed at the strain relief, I'll swap it today.

transcript.speaker: p-dmitri
transcript.text: Fine. Swap it, log it.

transcript.speaker: p-carlos
transcript.text: Left leg EVT unit, harness is still the blocker. I can do the mechanical side but I can't close it up.

transcript.speaker: p-nora
transcript.text: To restate, Carlos, mechanical is done but the unit can't close without the harness. Is there anything else on that unit that's also open, or is it just the one item?

transcript.speaker: p-carlos
transcript.text: Just the harness. Rest is ready.

transcript.speaker: p-zoe
transcript.text: uh, fixtures, the tilt stand angle sensor is reading weird again, drifting a bit when it warms up. i'll recal after lunch

transcript.speaker: p-dmitri
transcript.text: Okay. Andre, are you on?

transcript.speaker: p-andre
transcript.text: sorry sorry, joining late, my mic was muted

transcript.speaker: p-dmitri
transcript.text: No problem. Dyno status.

transcript.speaker: p-andre
transcript.text: dyno ran the hip actuator overnight, temp still climbing faster than we want. also we need the retainer by 8/6, the old one is chewed up

transcript.speaker: p-dmitri
transcript.text: The retainer, 8/6, got it. Is Talia on it?

transcript.speaker: p-andre
transcript.text: not yet, i'll ping her

transcript.speaker: p-nora
transcript.text: Could you repeat the date, Andre? I missed it on the audio.

transcript.speaker: p-andre
transcript.text: 8/6, the retainer

transcript.speaker: p-nora
transcript.text: Thank you. I'll note it for the build plan.

transcript.speaker: p-jade
transcript.text: receiving, nothing big came in yesterday, couple of small boxes for the bench

transcript.speaker: p-luis
transcript.text: i did the torque checks on the spare rig, one fastner was loose, *fastener, tightened it

transcript.speaker: p-dmitri
transcript.text: Good catch Luis.

transcript.speaker: p-zoe
transcript.text: also is the thermal camera free this week? i need it for the fixture check

transcript.speaker: p-lin
transcript.text: I can release it Wednesday after my run finishes.

transcript.speaker: p-zoe
transcript.text: ok thats fine, wed works

transcript.speaker: p-carlos
transcript.text: Anyone seen the good torque driver? It walked off again!!

transcript.speaker: p-luis
transcript.text: its on my cart, sorry, bringing it back

transcript.speaker: p-dmitri
transcript.text: Okay. If nothing else, let's go. Thanks everyone.

transcript.speaker: p-nora
transcript.text: One last thing, please update the tracker if anything slips so I can reflect it in the weekly.
